profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Android

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Successfully migrated the DraftKings Sportsbook app from Xamarin to a modern native Android app.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led a distributed team of 5 Android developers and collaborated cross-platform with iOS and SmartCast Platform Layer teams to develop SmartCast Mobile app for connecting and broadcasting to SmartCast TVs.
◦ Coordinated QA, beta testing and automated CI/CD processes (Bitrise, Github Actions).
◦ Led roadmap development, sprint planning, and backlog grooming.
◦ Drove hiring and onboarding process to double team headcount.
◦ Integrated stakeholder and user feedback into new features and improvement

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Developing SmartCast app for connecting and broadcasting to VIZIO smart TVs.
◦ Android development: Java, Kotlin, Android SDK.
◦ Networks: device control strategy for Google Cast and Vizio's REST/HTTP layer.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
◦Design:  Unified marketing for events, conferences, and center resources. Designed graphics for buttons and clothing. Adobe Creative Suite, Canva.
◦Outreach:  Fundraised over 5k for events and programs. Represented the Cantu to the Measure 15 Council. Tabling at events. Content for social media: reach increased 4x.
◦Organized and marketed Out in STEM event featuring panel of LGBT professionals in STEM. 
◦Received UCSC’s Leadership Service Award for contributions to the LGBTQIA community at UCSC.

positions.title: Streamlining Academic Advising Intern
positions.description:
◦ Analyzed progress of students with poor and satisfactory academic standing, in order to create a predictive model for academic standing with which to improve advising.
◦ Excel, SPSS.
◦ Part of the Chancellor's Undergraduate Internship Program (intern.ucsc.edu/cuip).

positions.title: Software Engineer (Co-Op)
positions.description:
◦Front End Development:  Updated graphical user interface for monitoring radar components.
◦Systems Integration and Testing:  Operated test automation suites for satellite ground systems.
◦Engineering Process:  S&I Engineering Bootcamp.  Agile methodology.

positions.title: SAR Beam and Modes Database Developer (Co-op)
positions.description:
◦ Software Design: Designed front end tools for managing the operational beams and modes of a synthetic aperture radar. Matlab, Python, MongoDB.
◦ Digital Signal Processing: Simulated digital signal processing algorithms in Matlab.

positions.title: Database Developer (Intern) for RADARSAT Constellation Mission
positions.description: Updating and adding functionality to a database. SQL.

honors.title: Leadership Service Award
honors.description: "You are a standout student leader and consistently show up for many communities in real and meaningful ways. While balancing leadership commitments across campus, you are a strong advocate for Queer & Trans students at UC Santa Cruz in all of these spaces. Thank you for the continued presence, work, and passion you bring to the Cantú. Your work as a Graphic Design intern for the Cantú has helped the Cantú breathe new life into the look and feel of the center's marketing and communications and plays a huge role in setting the tone for the overall mission of the Cantú in supporting all Queer and Trans student, faculty, and staff on campus. Beyond this, your continued commitment to help the Cantú in any way and support your fellow interns exemplifies what it means to be a Banana Slug. Thank you for building a stronger community at UC Santa Cruz."
honors.issuer: Issued by UC Santa Cruz Alumni · Sep 2017

honors.title: First Year Honors Program
honors.issuer: Issued by Crown College Provost · Sep 2014

volunteerExperiences.description: Redesigned and maintained main static website for civic education and public service programs, and responsive layout website for Camp Phoenix (an overnight camp accessible to kids who would not otherwise be able to attend summer camp). HTML/CSS.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: UCSC Student Health Outreach and Promotion Program
volunteerExperiences.description: Assisting with events including Vaginapalooza (an educational event centered around the health of women, both cis and trans, and trans men) and Take Back The Night.

company.name: UCSC Student Health Outreach and Promotion Program

projects.title: Smart Solar Siting
projects.description:
◦ Built a mobile app to perform solar siting surveys. Worked with sponsor to assess problem context and solutions and met throughout design and development process.
◦ Image Processing: Implemented OpenCV and Google Vision tools to detect obstructions and available sunlight.
◦ Android Development (Java): built application in Android Studio, using AR libraries. Contributed to design and implementation of UI (setting screen).
◦ Led scrum meetings, maintained documentation, wrote user's manual.

projects.title: SproutLabs Test Automation
projects.description:
Developed unit (Jest) and end-to-end (nightwatch.js and selenium) test suites for the SproutLabs VueJS web application.
Held pair programming and code review sessions, led scrum meetings, maintained documentation.
